question: What doctrinal claim fixes ritual commencement at dawn-time before the midpoint of the first watch?
premises: Ritual commencement is tied to a specified dawn-time interval.
The prescribed start occurs before half of the first watch.
This timing rule defines the permitted beginning window.
inference: The verse states the rite begins at dawn-time, just before half of the first watch, fixing that temporal claim.
plain_english: At dawn-time, just before half of the first watch, the ritual is to be begun.
